title: Integers past int64 in a JSON state, which upstream's template does not render faithfully
notes: Integers past int64 in a JSON state: the reference prints every digit; llama.cpp's template reads an unsigned one as int64 (2^64-1 prints -1) and a larger one as a double. Upstream renders 2^64-1 as -1 and 2^63 as -2^63 (int64 wrap), the 30-digit integer as a double; xybrid refuses the request. Written by tools/conformance/decision_hf/make_cases.py: upstream is left for the upstream oracle to fill, and the xybrid expectations are proposals.
